","^The rider wears a rust-red scarf and sits on a drum of oil with one boot up on the rim. She waves you over without getting up, as though she were calling a dog. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard","/#","
","^Kaplan wants the man at the north bend gone. He says the man slows the road, and a slow road feeds nobody. Ain wants him gone too, and Ain doesn't give reasons. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^Kaplan says do it clean. Move him on, and don't leave him in a ditch, because Kaplan won't pay for a body. He pays ","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},"out","/ev","^ M for a man who walks away. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^She spits over the rim of the drum and doesn't wait to hear what you say.","
",{"->":"road"},null],"shut":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"kiln_shut","re":true},"^The rider on the oil drum looks you over and doesn't wave. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard","/#","
","^Ain read a page with your name at the bottom of it. It says Kiln strips the dead. Kaplan sends nothing to a hand that signed a page like that. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^Ride out to the bend if you like. Kiln will remember which side your hand was on when you did. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^She puts her back to you and goes on polishing the stock of her rifle.","

","^The man sits on an ammunition box where the bend narrows. A grey scarf is wound twice round his neck, and a tin cup hangs from his belt. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^He lifts a hand, and you stop. He walks the length of your truck bed and looks closely at the gun mount.","
","^Show me your pins. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He crouches and puts a thumb on each pin one after another. He nods and lets you go on. Then he looks at the wall of the bend, where Emil Kessel's wreck lies burnt against the rock.","
","^Emil Kessel went off here last winter. His swivel slid on the curve and the gun came round into his cab. I was the one who found him. It had one pin, and a gun on one pin will do that on a bad bend. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^So I sit here and look at the pins. A driver with a single pin gets a choice from me. A second pin costs only a little at the Salvage Yard, and I pay it myself when the driver can't. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^The patch of a Scrapjaw outrider has been cut from the sleeve of his coat, but the stitches are still there.","
","^I rode for Scrapjaw once. I used to tell the drivers we robbed what to buy, so they wouldn't be robbed twice. Rook didn't like that, and Ain liked it less. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^Soldiers came up this bend after Emil with a clerk. They wrote the wreck down. They never wrote me down, and I'm the one who stayed. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
",{"->":"road"},null],"rise":["^You leave the truck at the foot of the bend and climb the loose rock above the narrow corner. A man can lie flat there and see the whole shelf. ","#","^place: The rise above the bend","/#","
","ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"saw_rise","re":true},"ev","str","^bendRise","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The light goes red and long. A cart comes up the north road with a Nose sergeant and a pair of soldiers on the board.","
","^They carry a crate into the rocks above the narrowest part of the corner and prop its lid open. Army rifles lie inside it, wrapped in fresh grease paper.","
","^The sergeant drops a bundle of red cloth on top of the rifles. He walks the line of the drop with his eyes, from the crate to the road and back. Then the cart goes down the way it came.","
",{"->":"rise.crate"},{"->":"rise.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You lie in the dust until the light goes. You see a cart, a great deal of rock and a lizard. Nothing else makes sense to you.","
","^At the foot of the bend a soldier leans on your truck and writes a line in a small book.","
","^A driver on the rise at dusk. Remember that, because I will. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"road"},{"->":"rise.15"},null]}],"nop","
",{"crate":[["ev","str","^Climb down to the crate and take a red scarf.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Go back down as you are.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"scarf","re":true},"^The cloth is new and stiff. It has never been worn. You fold it inside your coat and leave the lid exactly as it was.","
",{"->":"road"},null],"c-1":["

Ash watches you come all the way up the shelf. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^You tell him the post wants the bend clear. You tell him the next men to come will carry rifles and not words.","
","ev","str","^toughness","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You park the truck across the road and stand in front of it with your hands open and your feet apart. Ash looks at your shoulders for a long time. Then he looks at the road.","
","^He folds his scarf, packs the tin cup into his coat and stands up from the box.","
","^Tell Silver it's a public road. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He walks off up the bend and doesn't look back.","

","^At dusk a Nose truck takes the bend with its gun on a single pin. Nobody stops it to ask.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.32"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You park the truck across the road and stand in front of it. Ash doesn't so much as blink.","
","^A Nose truck with a single pin comes up behind you, and its driver leans on the horn. Ash takes his eyes off you, walks to the other truck and crouches by its mount as though you weren't there.","
","^Silver hears of it by dusk. A pair of soldiers who don't talk walk up the bend, and Ash comes down it between them.","
","^Silver pays nothing and calls it excuses. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^At dusk a Nose truck takes the bend with its gun on a single pin. Nobody stops it to ask.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.32"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"kaplan_job":["ev","str","^kiln","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You ride to the bend and tell Ash what Kaplan sent. Ash listens with his eyes on the wall. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You tell him Kaplan asked for him to be left alive, and Ain asked for nothing of the kind. You tell him which man will send the next rider.","
","^Kaplan was always the careful one. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He says he'll leave on his own legs, and Ain will hear he was driven out. He packs his tin cup. He doesn't take the road toward Kiln.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A Kiln rider counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"kaplan_pay"},"out","/ev","^ M into your hand at the Yard gate. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^By the end of the week a pair of riders sit where Ash sat. They don't ask to see pins. They ask to see your cargo.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You say what Kaplan said, and you say it badly. Ash laughs once, short and dry.","
","^Kaplan sends a message and Ain sends the riders. Which one did you think was coming? ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He doesn't move from the box. By dusk a pair of Kiln riders have taken the bend, and Ash is gone from it. Nobody will tell you how.","
","^A Kiln rider leans on the Yard gate and doesn't pay you. Kaplan asked for it to be clean, and clean didn't happen. ","#","^speaker: Rider","/#","
","^They sit where Ash sat. They don't ask to see pins. They ask to see your cargo.","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.24"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"warn":["ev","str","^ash","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You ride to the bend and tell Ash what both offers say. He listens without moving. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^Silver would send soldiers. Kaplan would send a rider who likes me. Neither one will ask twice. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He rolls the tin cup between his hands.","
","^I'll stay. A man can't hold a bend if he runs, and somebody has to look at the pins. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^You leave without the pay of either job.","
","end",null],"pins":["ev","str","^ash","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You hold out the money, and Ash doesn't take it at once. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^It'll go to the next driver who can't pay for his second pin. I'll write the name down. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
","^He tucks it into the tin cup. The next truck stops at the bend, and he's crouched by its mount before you're out of sight.","
","^He doesn't mention Silver or Kaplan. He doesn't need to.","
","end",null],"bench":["^You carry a drill, a clamp and a bar of hull plate up the bend and set them on a flat rock in the shade of the wall. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^Ash watches without a word. A truck with a single pin rolls up and stops for him.","
","ev","str","^machining","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^bench","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"^You clamp the Nose ring and bore the second hole true to the first. You ream it and set a pin. The driver tries the lock twice and grins.","
","^The next truck is a Yard hauler with a Nose mount. Ash puts out his hand for the coin and gives it back, because the bench takes no fee.","
","^By dusk the road behind you is full of trucks that don't need a thumb on their pins. Silver can say nothing against a mount that holds. The Administrator loses a fee on every one. Ash loses his reason to sit here.","
","end",{"->":"bench.17"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You clamp the ring and bore the hole. It runs off the mark by a hair, and you don't see it.","
","^The truck rolls on. A little way up the bend the pin walks and the gun swings across the bed. The driver wrestles it back and curses your name at the top of his lungs.","
","^Ash climbs the road to find him and comes back with a new ring on his shoulder.","
","ev",{"x()":"money"},{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},{"x()":"pay","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The ring comes out of your pocket. ","ev",{"VAR?":"bench_fee"},"out","/ev","^ M goes into Ash's tin. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],"nop","
","^Ash takes the drill from the rock and puts it back in your truck.","
","^Look at pins, friend. Don't make them. ","#","^speaker: Ash","/#","
",{"->":"road"},{"->":"bench.17"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"exposed":["^Sully Okafor listens with his back to the window and his coin still in his hand. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Crane office","/#","

","ev","str","^exposed","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"bend_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^yard","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"yard_power","re":true},"ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You lay the red scarf on his desk, and he flips it over. The edges are cut straight. It has never seen a day of wind.","
","^A pair of crane crews climb the bend before midnight. The crate is gone from the rocks when they reach them. The sergeant is standing by the bare stone, asking what they came for. ","#","^place: North bend","/#","
","^They show him the scarf. He looks at it for a long moment and says nothing. Then he looks at you.","
","^Back in the crane office, Sully hangs the scarf in his window where the post can see it. ","#","^place: Crane office","/#","
","^I show what I'm given, and the captain will know whose hand gave it to me. I can't stop that, and I won't pretend I tried. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","end",{"->":".^.^.^.13"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You tell him what you saw from the rise, and he hears it out without a word.","
","^A pair of crane crews climb the bend before midnight. When they reach the rocks there's only dust and stone.","
","^I can't show a soldier's shadow, friend. A story without a thing to hold is only weather. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","

","^You put the red scarf on his table. He looks at it for a long time. Then he opens the stove door and drops it in.","

facts.name: seen_ash
facts.text: North bend: Ash Kerimov stops every truck and asks to see its swivel pins.

facts.name: ash_story
facts.text: Ash: Emil Kessel died at this bend on a single pin. Ash pays for a second pin when a driver cannot. He rode for Scrapjaw once.

facts.name: heard_kaplan
facts.text: Kaplan: Kiln pays to see Ash gone from the bend. Kaplan asks that Ash be left alive.

facts.name: saw_rise
facts.text: The rise above the bend: a Nose cart left a crate of greased rifles in the rocks at dusk, with a bundle of Kiln red cloth on the lid.

facts.name: scarf
facts.text: You hold a Kiln red scarf, new and uncreased, from the crate.

bowl_bo.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^I am Bo Lindqvist. I drive a Granary truck on the Bowl road patrol. Sit down if you like. Most people who sit here have come to hear about a fight on the road, and I'll tell it once, if you want it.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What fight on the road?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is the road patrol?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Do you call yourself a killer?","/str",{"VAR?":"bo_fight"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why did you sign the patrol roll?","/str",{"VAR?":"bo_roll"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is a Brann swivel?","/str",{"VAR?":"bo_fight"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Where is Jens buried?","/str",{"VAR?":"bo_fight"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What became of Jens's brother?","/str",{"VAR?":"bo_fight"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The Vosk brothers had been stopping trucks on the Nose road for a long while. They always seemed to know which ones to stop. We carried a Brann swivel, a gun ring that swings across the truck bed, and I had never fired at a man.","
","^They came out of the wreck rows at the Burnt Convoy, a field of burned trucks beside the road. The road crews have cleared it since. I swung the ring and I fired, and Jens went down in the road. I stopped the truck and went back to him, but he was already gone.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"bo_fight","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^I drive with it, and I count my years on its roll the way some men count debts. The roll is the list of drivers who guard the roads near Bowl. A tenant like me has no vote until he's served on it for a decade, so I've still got years to go.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"bo_roll","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^I do, whatever the hall says. The tenant hall, where the tenants meet, sat on it and decided that a tenant who defends his load isn't a killer. They were kind about it.","
","^I sat quiet while they said it. The hall can say what it likes, but I know what my hand did.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^For the vote, mostly, but I'd be lying if I said it was only that. A man on the road with a rifle should be a man who's thought about it. I've thought about it every night since that day.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^It's a ring of hull plate that swings across the truck bed and locks with a pin. I think about ours most nights. Otto Brann made it, the welder at the Salvage Yard, and after that day he came and put a second pin on every swivel he'd made. He didn't say why, and he didn't need to.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Brother Anselm, who buried the dead of that road, put him in the ground by Canyon Bridge. It's across the road from Hal Sorensen, who died of the same trouble years before. Anselm lies there too now, between them.","
","^Lusa Fenwick reads their names at the bridge once a year. I go, and I stay for all of it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^He was never caught. Some say he hid among the scavenger families who lived at the Burnt Convoy, and some say he rides for the raiders at Kiln Camp. I don't ask.","
","^If he came to my truck I'd give him the grain, and I'd give him water. I'd give him anything that bought Jens his life back.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"bo_fight"},false,{"VAR=":"bo_roll"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_dag.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Dag. I ride with the Bowl Farmers, the patrol that keeps the roads near these walls. Keep your guns cold inside the gate and we'll get along fine.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is the road like?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who pays the Farmers?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who are the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you mean, pay the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_kiln"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do tenants serve with you?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_pay"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Dusty, and worse every season. A truck that breaks down out there waits a long time for a friendly face, so carry water and a spare belt, and don't wander off the track.","
","^Raiders sniff around the roads too. It's nothing we can't run off, but you'll want your gun ready.","
","^The Army at Nose watches the stretch in front of its own gate, and it does that well enough.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_road","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
",["ev",{"x()":"board_full"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You're carrying enough promises already. Finish a few and then ask me again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!",{"x()":"has_offers"},"&&","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^There's nothing on the board you could take right now. Make some room on your truck and ask again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The board's empty today. Come back in a couple of days, it fills slowly.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],"nop","
","^I might have a haul for you, if you want it. ","#","^work_offer","/#","
",["ev","str","^I will take it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not now.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"x()":"take_work"},"pop","/ev","
","^Good. Bowl remembers the people who deliver, so don't make me regret this.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-2":["
","^Not enough people, to be plain. The Granary pays out of its count of sacks. The drivers who cross Canyon Bridge pay a toll, the long convoys pay a fee, and the tenants put in a share of their harvest.","
","^Nose pays nothing, because it guards only its own walls. So each town watches the road by its own gate and nobody watches between the towns. I don't like it, and I don't know a cure.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_pay","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^There's a pair of camps. Kiln Camp sits out east, south of the big crater, and Scrapjaw Camp is far up north. Most days they'd rather rob you than kill you, because a dead driver hauls nothing next week.","
","^So pay them or outrun them, but don't fire the first shot if you want to grow old.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^The Army's all right on the road. Off it, they act as though the basin belongs to them and the rest of us are only borrowing it. Bowl was feeding people long before Nose put up its first fence.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The Granary pays Kiln Camp a sack of grain for every armed truck that crosses their road. It costs less than a funeral.","
","^If they close on you anyway, fight hard. They often let a hard fighter go, and they strip a soft one down to the frame. Don't start the fight. But once they start it, don't hold back.","
","ev","str","^talkKilnFight","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Some do. They're good drivers, but they've got no vote, so they ride in our coats without being on the roll of citizens. The Senate wants them on the road and off the roll.","
","^Jory Baptiste keeps sending more of them, and I can't decide whether to thank him or watch him.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_road"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_pay"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_hattie.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Water's for paying folk, but talk's free. I'm Hattie, I keep the well house, and I hear everything that happens in Bowl twice. Once when it happens, and once when somebody's improved it. Bucket down and ears open.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Heard any rumors?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any local legends?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who comes through here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you make of the soldiers from Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What about the glass at the Glass Flats?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is it true the Sunward take strangers?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Funny you ask. A scavenger came through a few days back, trying to sell a Nose Army radio. He swore he'd pulled it off an Army wagon sitting dead in the hills north-east of here.","
","^When the Farmers asked him where exactly, he filled his tank and left for Nose in a hurry. Now, I say a man that quick to leave has something to hide.","
","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^You know the Glass Flats, out east, where the ground melted into glass? There's supposed to be an Old World tank out there that still runs. It rolls out at night with its lights off.","
","^My cousin saw it. Well, he heard it, and my cousin hears a great deal when he's been drinking.","
","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_flats","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Somebody every day, mind you. Traders, couriers, folk with a tank of fuel and a story to go with it. The ones that worry me are the quiet ones who ask where the seed stores are.","
","^Soldiers come down from Nose to buy water too. They're polite, I'll give them that.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Soldiers playing at being a town, if you ask me. They eat our grain and send us orders back, and they're perfectly polite whenever they want something.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Pim Arslan, who cuts lenses, says every ripple in it leans the same way, toward the Fallen Sun. That's the crater where the ship came down. My cousin says it points at heaven, but my cousin drinks.","
","^Sun or heaven, I won't stand on it at noon. The Sunward have their own opinion, mind. They worship whatever lies in that crater, and they'll share it with anyone who stands still.","
","ev","str","^talkGlassLean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^That's what they say. A stranger goes into the crater with the Sunward and doesn't come out. I say folk do come out, green at the edges and quiet.","
","^I've never followed one in. Water's for paying folk, not for asking.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardTake","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_flats"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_jory.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Jory Baptiste. I speak for the tenants, which is to say I talk and the Senate nods off. Sit down, the stool's free. It's the only free thing in Bowl, so enjoy it.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^How does a tenant get a vote?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you send tenants into the patrol?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_patrol"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the patrol trouble you?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the raiders have to do with the grain?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who is Bo Lindqvist?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do the top terraces stay green?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_nose"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^We grow the food, and the citizens eat it. You can tell us apart by the dirt under the nails. We work the families' terraces and keep a share of what we grow. We've no vote in the Senate, so the families decide what we plant and what we're paid.","
","^The top terraces, where the old families live, stay green even in a dry year. Nobody's explained that to me, and I wouldn't dare ask. A miracle's a miracle.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_green","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_nose","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^He serves in the Bowl road patrol for a decade. Then the Senate lets him drop a pebble in a jar. My grandfather died one season short, which was bad timing, but he always kept his own schedule.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_patrol","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Because the Senate wrote the rule and I read it back to them slowly. They said service earns a vote, so I send them the service. They let tenants carry rifles on the road and pay half the cost on grain runs, and nobody asked what a rifle in a tenant's hands might mean on voting day.","
","^The first tenant to sign the patrol roll was Bo Lindqvist, who drives for the Granary. The patrol knows my face by now, too. I've noticed the patrol and the raiders in the south get paid out of the same sacks, but that's a longer story. I've been told I'm a long story myself.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_filled","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It does, and it knows where I live. They searched my house at night once and said they were looking for a rifle. They found a spoon, and I told them to keep it because I've got more. A man should be known by somebody.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Kiln Camp, the raiders in the south, gets a sack from the Granary for every armed truck that crosses their road. The patrol is paid out of the tenants' share of the same grain. We pay Kiln and we pay the patrol, and we pay both with the same grain.","
","^The sack leaves the store once and the Senate counts it twice. Odile Marsh, who keeps the Granary, chalks the count on the gate at night. Go and read it, and you'll see both lines are our grain. The Senate says it all adds up, and it does, the way a bucket with a hole adds up.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^A tenant who drives for the Granary, and gentle as a tired ox. Don't joke with him about the fight he had on the road. I joke about everything else, but I know where the edge is.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Because, if the word's right, a pipe runs from the seep up to the top gardens. The seep's the little spring in the rock above the terraces. No meter's allowed to read that pipe, and if you say so in the market they'll send for a meter, so I say it only here.","
","^Have I seen the pipe? No. I've seen the kitchen gardens up there, and they're very green for a dry year. Either the pipe exists or those cabbages are saints.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^They ration everyone and call it kindness. A fed man in a line is still a man in a line. Ask me again in a famine and I might change my mind, or I might not, because I'm a stubborn fellow when I'm hungry.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_patrol"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_filled"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_green"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_nose"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_names.story: {"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^stat: money Money","/#","#","^fact: drunk_said Toll hut: a drunk man says Karl Vosk shot Hal Sorensen below the bridge, the year the road went unguarded.","/#","#","^fact: brass_held Spent brass from the drunk man: Old Army rifle, found on the road below the bridge the morning after Hal was shot.","/#","#","^fact: runner Toll hut: a wheel is burned into the heel of the drunk man's boot.","/#","#","^fact: book_seen Dario Feld's book, the day before: a pair of men in Army coats watched the trucks from the rise below the bridge. The younger had red thread at his cuff.","/#","#","^fact: hal_letter_read Hal's last letter: a stranger on the road offered him a rifle for grain, and he wouldn't pay for a thing he hadn't asked for.","/#","#","^fact: kiln_known Guild mail: a letter capped with a Burnt Convoy seal was addressed to Karl Vosk at Kiln Camp.","/#"," ",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"proof":["ev",{"VAR?":"drunk_said"},{"VAR?":"brass_held"},"+",{"VAR?":"book_seen"},"+",{"VAR?":"kiln_known"},{"VAR?":"letter_fate"},"str","^read","/str","==","||",{"VAR?":"letter_fate"},"str","^delivered","/str","==","||","+","/ev","~ret",null],"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#",["ev",{"VAR?":"outcome"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str","!=","||","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":[" ",{"->":"after_reading"},{"->":"start.4"},null]}],"nop"," ","^Lusa Fenwick sits on an upturned crate by the Bowl well with a worn sheet of road drawing across her knees. She isn't drawing this morning. She's saying names under her breath, one after another, and ticking each against the edge of the sheet with her thumbnail. ","#","^place: Bowl","/#"," ","^She looks up and smiles at you, as if she'd been waiting for a quiet face."," ","^Tonight's the night. Once a year, on the day the road below Canyon Bridge first took someone, I stand on the bridge deck and read the names of the people it's taken since. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","^Drivers come from all over the basin. They park along the deck and stand bareheaded beside their cabs, and each one answers when a name is read, like men answering a roll. Nobody asked us to start it. We only never stopped. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","^I saw you at the well yesterday with no cab to be in tonight. Come with me. A reading goes better with someone in it who doesn't carry any of them yet. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who is on the list?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^I'll come.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not tonight.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":[" ","^Hal Sorensen drove grain for the Granary, and he was shot below the bridge the year the road went unguarded. Jens Vosk was a robber who died to a tenant's swivel at the Burnt Convoy, back when the burnt trucks still stood by the road. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","^Brother Anselm buried both of them, one on each side of the road, and he's buried between them now. Wendell Ondra kept the pump book at the Pump Station and died at the Green Pit sluice. Emil Kessel drove for Nose and died on the north bend, on a mount with a single pin. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","^I read them all the same way, a robber beside a driver. The road doesn't sort them, so I don't try. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":[" ","ev","str","^namesReading","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ","^Good. Wear something warm, because the wind off the gorge is cold even in summer. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ",{"->":"reading"},null],"c-2":[" ","^The names get read again next year, and they won't mind waiting. ","#","^speaker: Lusa","/#"," ","end",null]}],null]}],"reading":[["^Canyon Bridge hangs over the gorge with the last light on its rails, and the wind hums in the cables like a long held note. Trucks stand along the bare deck with their cabs dark, and the drivers stand beside them with their caps in their hands. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The bridge deck","/#"," ","^A toll hut sits at the Bowl end. Graves lie at the far end, and Hal's and Jens's face each other across the road while Anselm's lies between."," ","^Lusa stands in the middle of the deck with her back to the drop. She reads without a book, in a clear voice that carries to the last truck."," ","^Hal Sorensen, who drove the Granary's grain and would not pay a stranger for a rifle he hadn't asked for."," ","^Here, says a voice from a cab. Others take it up."," ","^Jens Vosk, who robbed insured trucks on the Nose road and died to a tenant's swivel. ","#","^reveal: all","/#"," ","^Nobody answers for a moment. Then a driver at the back says it, low."," ","^Brother Anselm, who buried them. Wendell Ondra, who kept the pump book. Emil Kessel, who drove the north road for Nose."," ","^Each name gets its answer. The wind takes the last one off the bridge."," ","ev","str","^Stay until the crowd breaks up.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Leave before the last name.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":[" ",{"->":"after_reading_scene"},null],"c-1":[" ","^You're on the road before she finishes. The bridge hums behind you."," ","end",null]}],null],"after_reading_scene":["^The trucks start one by one and file off the deck, and their lamps swing across the rails. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The bridge deck","/#"," ","^At the toll hut a man sits on the step with a bottle between his boots. He's loud and drunk, though not unkind, and he's watched you since the reading began."," ","^You stayed to the end. Sit down, will you? Nobody ever sits with me. ","#","^speaker: Drunk man","/#"," ",{"->":".^.hub_drunk"},{"hub_drunk":[["#","^checkpoint: after_reading_scene.hub_drunk","/#","ev","str","^Sit with him.","/str",{"VAR?":"drunk_said"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Buy him a drink. ","#","^cost: ","ev",{"VAR?":"drink_price"},"out","/ev","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"drunk_said"},{"VAR?":"brass_held"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Look at how he's sitting.","/str",{"VAR?":"drunk_said"},{"VAR?":"runner"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Go and find Lusa.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":[" ","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"drunk_said","re":true},"ev","str","^namesDrunk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev"," ","^He pats the step, and you sit."," ","^She reads Jens like he was a saint, and that's the part I can't stand. facts.name: drunk_said
facts.text: Toll hut: a drunk man says Karl Vosk shot Hal Sorensen below the bridge, the year the road went unguarded.

facts.name: brass_held
facts.text: Spent brass from the drunk man: Old Army rifle, found on the road below the bridge the morning after Hal was shot.

facts.name: runner
facts.text: Toll hut: a wheel is burned into the heel of the drunk man's boot.

facts.name: book_seen
facts.text: Dario Feld's book, the day before: a pair of men in Army coats watched the trucks from the rise below the bridge. The younger had red thread at his cuff.

facts.name: hal_letter_read
facts.text: Hal's last letter: a stranger on the road offered him a rifle for grain, and he wouldn't pay for a thing he hadn't asked for.

facts.name: kiln_known
facts.text: Guild mail: a letter capped with a Burnt Convoy seal was addressed to Karl Vosk at Kiln Camp.

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sit a while, the shade is free. I am Ruben, and I keep the canal gates. That means I decide which fields drink first, so I'm used to being cursed by people who are only thirsty. What is on your mind?","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is this place?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who runs Bowl?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get water, or find work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What did your grandmother tell you about the old days?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_old"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_sun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun really?","/str","str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Green Pit feeder?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_water"},"str","^green-pit","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What are the tenants saying?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why did the Senate refuse the loan from Pierce?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Bowl is a farm built in terraces down the inside of a crater. The canals here still carry water, and water runs downhill, and so do people. Folk came for the canals and stayed for the seed.","
","^My grandmother kept these same gates before me. She liked to say that a town is only a field that learned to talk.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_old","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^The canal families do. Every gate has a family that tends it, and every family has a say in the Senate, the council of citizens that decides for all of Bowl. It is a slow way to decide anything, but nobody I know has starved waiting for a quick answer.","
","^The tenants who work the terraces for the families aren't citizens, so they have no seat. In the last drought, Pierce Corporation offered the Senate a long loan of grain. Pierce insures trucks and lends money, and the Senate argued over that loan for a whole season.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_senate","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Water is Hattie's trade. She keeps the well house and sells a bucket to anyone with coin. Work is Dag's, because he rides with the Farmers and knows what hauls are waiting.","
","^I only open the gates. The water that goes through them belongs to the families, and it comes down a feeder channel from Green Pit. That's a pump outpost out on the flat. Their pumps pull water up from deep rock, and what they don't sell by the can runs down to us.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^She said the whole basin was orchards in her time, from wall to wall, and the canals ran full in every season. Then the sky fell and the fruit went with it. She never could agree with herself on which came first.","
","^What fell is what people call the Fallen Sun.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^People say it was a ship, bigger than all of Bowl. It came down burning and dug a crater out in the basin. Some say it brought the end of the world with it, but I say the end was already here. The ship only added one more bucket to a field that was flooded already.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^So you've stood in that crater, and you know more of it than I do. Nose calls the ship a warship, and Hattie at the well house calls it a seed ship that lost its way. I can only tell you that nothing grows near it, and of any place that is the worst thing I know how to say.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^In a dry year the Senate hung a meter on it and claimed a share for Bowl, as if the feeder had ever been ours to measure. That year the pumps at Green Pit drew mud by noon, and nobody asked the pumps what they thought.","
","^Wendell Ondra died at the sluice there, the little gate where the feeder lets its water in. His niece Agnes keeps the book at the Pump Station, and she writes down every drop.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^They say they feed Bowl and have no say in it, and they're right. The families never wanted to tell a tenant what to think, only what to plant.","
","^Jory Baptiste speaks for them on the terraces. He is quick, and I like him, and I vote against him anyway.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Because Pierce wanted the canal gates as surety. If a dry year came and we couldn't pay, Pierce would own the water, and the families would be tenants on their own terraces.","
","^My grandmother would have thrown the man in the canal. The Senate only argued with him for a season, which I suppose is how we throw people now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_old"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_senate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_water"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: office_files
facts.text: Pierce filing room: hook crates left by the north gate in Dell Marr's hand, week after week. His last line ends mid-word, and the pages after it are cut out.

facts.name: yard_tally
facts.text: Crane book: hook crates left the old yard by the north gate, week after week. Each line ends with a sealed order and one initial, L.

facts.name: otto_wheel
facts.text: Otto: he strapped the hook crates for the yard and signed each strap. The wheel crates went out roped.

facts.name: otto_lid
facts.text: Otto's bench, Salvage Yard: a crate lid with a hook burned in, strapped with Otto's mark. Chalk on the edge says north gate, by L.

facts.name: mara_copy
facts.text: Mara Kessel's old case, second copy: the day each insured truck was filed at the Nose office and the night it was stopped on the road. The last line sends the clerk west, by order, L.

facts.name: caught
facts.text: Filing room: the clerk at the side table wrote a line when you took the book down.

",{"->":"look"},null]}],null],"look":[["#","^checkpoint: look","/#","^Out past the hood, where the dust is settling, the other truck has stopped side on. It's too far to hit with a thrown stone, not that you could lift one. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Its gun is still swung your way, and a thin grey thread of smoke climbs from the muzzle and leans off with the wind. A figure in goggles stands braced in the bed with both hands on the grips.","
","^Your hands have gone heavy in your lap, and this time they won't lift. You wonder, calm as anything, how long a body keeps in this heat. Not long, you figure. Then the dust gets it, and then nobody remembers there was a truck here at all. One with the dust, then.","
","ev","str","^Hold the gunner's gaze.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Close your eyes and wait.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^You can't see the eyes behind the goggles. You look anyway. It's the last thing left you can choose, and you'll be damned if you choose the floor.","
",{"->":"mercy"},null],"c-1":["
","^You listen to the wind push sand across the hood, and you wait for the sound you won't get to hear.","
",{"->":"mercy"},null]}],null],"mercy":["^The sound doesn't come. ","#","^page","/#","
","^When you look again, the barrel has swung up and away and points at nothing in the empty sky. The gunner pushes the goggles up, spits over the side and climbs down.","
","^They walk to your truck slow, with a rifle slung across their back, and they don't even glance at the cab as they pass. The bed creaks under their weight. For a while you listen to them sort through what you carried, unhurried, like somebody doing chores.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"intro_step"},"str","^ambush","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Then the hood creaks up, and a wrench works at something in the engine bay for a long while. ",{"->":"mercy.17"},null]}],"nop","
","^On the way back they stop by your door. A dented canteen lands on the seat beside you, half full and sloshing. Then boots on gravel, a door slamming, and an engine climbing off into the flat until the wind takes it. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You're alive. You hold onto that the way you'd hold a rope. It's enough to keep the canteen in your lap while the dark comes up around the edges of everything, soft and patient and in no hurry at all.","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

granary_driver.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Bowl road patrol, grain run. Talk if you like, friend, but I'm checking pins while you do. Don't take it personal if I'm looking at the truck and not at you.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you haul?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is the road like out here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is on the Granary gate?","/str",{"VAR?":"driver_haul"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you trust Kiln?","/str",{"VAR?":"driver_haul"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What are the tenants like on the patrol?","/str",{"VAR?":"driver_haul"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What became of the Old Army?","/str",{"VAR?":"driver_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do they do differently past the canyon?","/str",{"VAR?":"driver_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Grain, from the Granary to wherever the Senate points me. I'm late with this load because a pin on my ring was loose. A pair of steel pins holds the ring to the bed, and I've seen what one pin does on a bend. So I check both at every stop, and I'll check yours too if you let me.","
","^Every crossing of Kiln Camp's road costs the Granary a sack, so I keep my load tight. A sack's cheaper than a truck, I tell myself. Odile Marsh, the steward, chalks every sack on the gate at night.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"driver_haul","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Empty, once you're between the towns. Each town guards the road by its own walls, and Nose won't pay for a guard on the rest. Every truck's its own patrol, and I'd sleep better with somebody else on the road.","
","^The Old Army kept the whole road once, before my time. And I hear folk past the canyon do it differently, but I've only heard it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"driver_road","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Odile's counts, and I've watched her chalk them. One board holds the sacks we pay Kiln. The one beside it holds the tenants' share that pays for the patrol. She was a tenant herself, and some of us still call her a turncoat behind her back.","
","^She counts every sack twice, at night, and she doesn't blink.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^I trust them to act like Kiln. If you pay, they let you through. If you fight hard they often let you through anyway, and if you do neither they strip the truck down to the frame.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Good drivers. They sit at the back of the hall and don't complain, and I've seen worse men with a vote.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^It ended and left hungry soldiers behind. My uncle was in it. He told me how soldiers came to the gate of Old Orchard, its depot, at night and were turned away. Some of them are on my crew, and I'll say this for hungry soldiers, they make fine drivers.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^The tale is that trucks there carry no guns, because a guard every town pays for keeps the roads. Lusa Fenwick rode west with a convoy once, and she came back telling it. She's a dreamer.","
","^I haven't been west, and neither has anyone who swears to it.","
","ev","str","^talkWestTowns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"driver_haul"},false,{"VAR=":"driver_road"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","ev",{"VAR?":"lien"},"/ev","~ret",null],"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^At the edge of the Glass Flats lies a field of open pods, rusted shells half sunk in the dust beside the fused glass, and the wind sets their hatches creaking like a congregation. ","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^A line of posts, welded from hull plate, follows the debris trail across it with a lamp on top of each.","
","^An old woman sits on a stool at the foot of the first post with a rag in her lap. A young man with a stiff leg is already on the ladder.","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"foot":[["#","^checkpoint: foot","/#","^The Granary cart stands at the foot of the ladder, and a man in a Pierce coat writes in a book on its tailboard. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","

","^A pair of the clerk's men stand by the cart now, with their hands resting on their belts.","

","ev","str","^Walk the line of lamps.","/str",{"VAR?":"lamps_seen"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Sit with Juno.","/str",{"VAR?":"juno_said"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Go up the ladder with Tam.","/str",{"VAR?":"tam_said"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask the carter for his slip.","/str",{"VAR?":"slip_read"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Pay the clerk the lien on the dark lamp. ","^You walk the line in the low light, and each post carries a number in fresh yellow paint on a plate welded below the lamp. ","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^Post; Lien paint; Oil tank ","#","^head","/#","
","^First; 4417; full ","#","^row","/#","
","^Second; 4418; full ","#","^row","/#","
","^Third; 4419; half ","#","^row","/#","
","^Fourth; 4420; half ","#","^row","/#","
","^Fifth; 4421; low ","#","^row","/#","
","^Last; 4422; empty ","#","^row","/#","
","^On the third post the paint has flaked, and under it an older number shows in a thinner hand. It is not the yellow one.","
","^The lien plates are riveted over the hull, and the old numbers were stamped into the hull itself long before any paint.","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"juno":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"juno_said","re":true},"^Juno Pell does not get up. Her hands are knotted like roots, and she keeps working the rag between them. ","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^I know every pod on this field by its number, child. I knew them long before Pierce came and painted over them. ","#","^speaker: Juno","/#","
","^The Granary buys our oil. I sell to them first so the roof holds over our heads, and the lamps get whatever's left. ","#","^speaker: Juno","/#","
","^The last one's resting. Every lamp is a pod and every pod is somebody, and not one of them goes dark while I'm alive. ","#","^speaker: Juno","/#","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"tam":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"tam_said","re":true},"ev","str","^lampsOil","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The ladder is cold iron, and Tam climbs it one rung at a time with his bad leg dragging behind him. ","#","^place: The last lamp","/#","
","^A Scrapjaw rider shot me in this leg when they took the fuel truck. Now I climb because she can't. ","#","^speaker: Tam","/#","
","^The can was heavier last year. Every week since, it's come up lighter. ","#","^speaker: Tam","/#","
","^The last lamp is dry to the wick, and there's a tag from the Pierce office wired to its post. She doesn't know. If that lamp goes, she goes with it. ","#","^speaker: Tam","/#","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"slip":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"slip_read","re":true},"^The carter holds the slip out without being asked twice. ","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^Item; Paid by; Paid to ","#","^head","/#","
","^Lamp oil, per can; The Granary; Pierce office, lien book ","#","^row","/#","
","ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"paper_seen","re":true},"^A paper is rolled in his coat under the slip. It carries the Granary's seal, and the ink on it is older than the dark lamp.","
",{"->":"slip.28"},null]}],"nop","
","^The clerk does not look up from his book.","
","^The Granary pays by the can, and the Corporation takes the coin and writes it against her mother's tag. ","#","^speaker: Clerk","/#","
","^A lien is a debt written against a thing, and this one grows every quarter faster than the oil pays it down. The dark lamp falls due before the next cart comes. ","#","^speaker: Clerk","/#","
","^If you pay what's owed on it, the Corporation will leave the post alone. ","#","^speaker: Clerk","/#","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"paid":["ev","str","^paid","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^debtor","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lien_standing","re":true},"ev",{"f()":"lien_due"},"/ev",{"temp=":"due"},"
","^The clerk takes ","ev",{"VAR?":"due"},"out","/ev","^ M and dips a brush. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The last lamp","/#","
","^He paints a plain stroke over the yellow number, and the tag of Pierce paper comes off the post.","
","^He writes in his book as well. It is your name and your truck, set down beside the number, and Juno never sees the line.","
","^Tam fills the tank from the can on his back. At dusk he lights the wick, and the last lamp burns with the rest.","
","^Juno watches from her stool. She says nothing, but her lips move as if she were counting.","
","end",null],"plate":["^You climb the ladder behind Tam with a torch and a chisel on your belt. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The last lamp","/#","
","^The clerk's plate sits under the dry lamp, yellow on grey, riveted to the hull. The old number lies beneath it, stamped into the plate itself.","
","ev","str","^machining","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
",{"->":"plated"},{"->":"plate.19"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"burnt"},null],"plated":["ev","str","^plated","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^enemy","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lien_standing","re":true},"^You cut the rivets one at a time and ease the plate away before the metal can ring. The old number comes up clean under the grinder, stamped deep.","
","^The clerk climbs a few rungs, sees the bare hull and the stamp, and stops. He has a number in his book and no plate to put it on.","
","^I'll write the post down as unknown and send for a surveyor. He'll come after the next cart. ","#","^speaker: Clerk","/#","
","^Tam fills the tank and lights the wick, and the last lamp burns with the rest.","
","^The clerk writes your truck on a page by itself. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","end",null],"burnt":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"guarded","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"quarter"},"/ev",{"temp=":"due"},"ev",{"x()":"money"},{"VAR?":"due"},"<","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["

","^The torch bites the tank seam and oil weeps down the post. Tam beats out the flame with his coat.","
","^The clerk climbs the ladder faster than a man his age should, and a pair of his men follow him. ","#","^place: The last lamp","/#","
","^He sends a bill for the tank and the seam, and it comes to ","ev",{"VAR?":"due"},"out","/ev","^ M. The lien on the post grows by a quarter. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"hold":["^You walk out to where the cart must pass and stand in the track. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^The clerk's pair comes up with their hands on their belts. Tam watches from the ladder, and Juno does not look up.","
","ev","str","^toughness","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},3,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
",{"->":"held"},{"->":"hold.19"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"shoved"},null],"held":["ev","str","^held","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^enemy","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lien_standing","re":true},"^You stay where you are and let them look at you. Neither of them has been paid enough for what it would take to move you.","
","^The clerk looks at the sky and writes in his book, and the cart goes back the way it came.","
","^The Corporation will send armed men next quarter. I say so only as a courtesy. ","#","^speaker: Clerk","/#","
","^That night every lamp burns, the last one too, and it burns well. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","end",null],"shoved":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"guarded","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"quarter"},"/ev",{"temp=":"due"},"ev",{"x()":"money"},{"VAR?":"due"},"<","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["

",{"->":"shoved.14"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"due"},{"x()":"pay","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A rifle butt finds your ribs and a boot finds the rest of you. They take ","ev",{"VAR?":"due"},"out","/ev","^ M from your coat for obstructing a lawful cart. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^The clerk writes in his book. The lien on the post grows by a quarter, and the cart rolls on.","

",{"->":"sour_deal"},null],"leased":["ev","str","^leased","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"^The carter does not meet your eye. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"paper_seen"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You say you can read a seal across a tailboard, and that a paper dated before the lamp went dark is a paper the Senate will want explained.","
",{"->":"leased.18"},null]}],"nop","
","^You tell him a sale is a quarrel and a lease is a cart that comes every week. He flips the paper over and writes a word in the margin.","
","^The Granary will light the lamps with its own crew and rope, pay Juno rent in oil, and pay the clerk down from that rent. Juno and Tam keep the ladder.","
","^Juno signs, and then she asks what a lease is. Tam tells her it's a sale that lets her keep her stool. ","#","^speaker: Tam","/#","
","^At dusk a Bowl crew lights the lamps beside Tam. The old woman stays on her stool and looks out over the field. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","end",null],"sour_deal":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"sour","re":true},"^The carter listens to the end. Then he rolls the paper and puts it back in his coat. ","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^Odile didn't send me here to be taught my own trade. ","#","^speaker: Carter","/#","
","^He tells the yard what you said. By the time you reach the ladder, Tam has gone up it and will not come down.","
",{"->":"foot"},null],"kept":["ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"^The carter looks at the old woman, then at you. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^He shrugs and swings the cart round, and the oil stays on the field.","
","^That night every lamp burns, the last one too, thin and yellow. Far off at the Granary the weigh house runs on tallow.","
","^The clerk writes in his book. The lien grows by a quarter.","
","end",null],"sold":["ev","str","^sold","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"offer"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The carter unrolls a paper. The Granary will take the lamps and keep them lit with its own crew and rope. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Glass Flats","/#","
","^Nobody climbs the ladder with a bad leg after that, and Tam can say that much for it.","
","^Juno signs her mother's name with a hand that shakes. She does not ask what the paper says.","
","^The carter asks for a witness's mark under hers, and you give it. Tam reads it from the ladder and spits.","
","^The carter counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"offer"},"out","/ev","^ M into your palm for carrying it. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^At dusk a Bowl crew lights the lamps. The old woman stays on her stool and looks at the field.","

facts.text: Posts: every lamp is painted with a Pierce lien number. Under the flaking paint on one post an older number shows, in a thinner hand.

facts.name: juno_said
facts.text: Juno: she sells oil to the Bowl first and lights the lamps with what is left. The last lamp is resting, she says.

facts.name: tam_said
facts.text: Tam: the oil can is lighter every week. The last lamp is dry, and a Pierce tag is wired to its post.

facts.name: slip_read
facts.text: Carter's slip: the Granary pays for the oil, and the coin goes to a Pierce clerk. Juno's name is not on it.

facts.name: paper_seen
facts.text: Carter's coat: a rolled paper under a Granary seal. Its date is older than the dark lamp.

","^A pair of boards that I chalk myself at night, after I've counted the store. One shows the sacks we pay to Kiln Camp, a sack for every armed truck of ours that crosses their road. The other shows the tenants' share for the road patrol, the men who guard the roads near the Bowl. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","
","^I light the lamps over the gate at the same hour, with oil from the beacon field on the edge of the Glass Flats. Lately my count has troubled me more than the lamps do. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","

","^Because if we don't, Kiln strips the grain trucks on the road, and a Granary that loses its trucks loses its winter. My grandmother lived through the year the grain ran out. She ate boiled sacking. I'd rather pay raiders every season than see that year again. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Bowl men and tenants together. The Granary count helps pay them, along with the bridge toll and the convoy fee. The Nose pays nothing and grumbles when it's asked. A tenant who serves enough years earns a vote, so they line up to join. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","
","^I send grain every month to one of them, a man named Ilya Moreno. He holds the Old Orchard gate in a Bowl coat and still calls himself a corporal. Yesterday a rider came from him with a message I didn't like. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_orchard","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^The store loses more sacks every night than both boards add up to. I've counted it over and over. I can't say so aloud to the tenants, because they'd say I'm short on purpose. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","

That's east of here and a little north, where the pods came down thickest. She sells the Bowl her oil, and my carter tells me her end lamp stands dark. I don't like a dark lamp. ","#","^speaker: Odile","/#","

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["

facts.name: log_read
facts.text: Gate log: every armed truck chalked as it crossed, and a sack owed to Kiln for each. Both columns agree.

facts.name: store_read
facts.text: Store book: more sacks left the store this week than the boards add up to.

facts.name: carter_said
facts.text: Carter: the collector at the drop keeps the tally on his own stick. The carters never see it.

facts.name: drop_seen
facts.text: Kiln drop: the collector notched his stick for sacks that never left a cart. A second wagon waits behind the rocks.

facts.name: weigher_said
facts.text: Night weigher: he signs sacks out after the sentry goes off. His cousin eats from the store.

facts.name: beam_read
facts.text: Weighing block: the poise weight on the beam is lighter than its stamp. The file marks on its edge are bright.

facts.name: stick_taken
facts.text: Collector's stick: a row of notches for the carts, and a second row with no cart behind it.

intro_arrival.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The canteen has been empty since dawn. You shake it by your ear anyway, and nothing moves inside. ","#","^place: The rim","/#","
","^You have walked since the stars were out. The cap is too hot to hold for long. Your shirt is stiff with salt where the sweat dried, and wet again under the arms.","
","ev","str","^Wipe your mouth.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Tuck the canteen away.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^walk","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^Your lips are split at the corners. The back of your hand comes away gritty and a little pink.","
",{"->":"rim"},null],"c-1":["
","ev","str","^walk","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^It knocks against your hip with every step.","
",{"->":"rim"},null]}],null],"rim":[["#","^checkpoint: rim","/#","^The rock you have been climbing all morning ends at an edge. Below it lies a basin, so wide that the far side is a paler line in the haze. ","#","^page","/#","
","^To the north a thin line might be a road. Past it, something in the haze might be a town.","
","^At the foot of the slope a water tower stands over a few roofs. There's no smoke and nothing moves. A tower means a well, or it used to.","
","ev","str","^Look back the way you came.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Look down the slope.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Rock and shimmer, the same as yesterday. There's no water back there either.","
",{"->":"slope"},null],"c-1":["
","^Loose scree, then hard dirt, then the tower. Half a morning's walk, if your knees hold.","
",{"->":"slope"},null]}],null],"slope":[["#","^checkpoint: slope","/#","^You go down sideways and dig your heels in. Stones slide out from under your boots and clatter away below you. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Halfway down you stop sweating. You know what that means, and you keep going.","
","ev","str","^Rest in the shade of a boulder.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Keep walking.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The shade is a hand wide. You sit in it until your breath slows, then make yourself stand before sitting starts to feel like a plan.","
",{"->":"farm"},null],"c-1":["
","^If you sit down now, you might not get up. You keep walking.","
",{"->":"farm"},null]}],null],"farm":[["#","^checkpoint: farm","/#","^Up close the tank is rusted brown and stands on thin iron legs. A gun mount is bolted to the rail at the top, with nothing in it. Somebody kept watch from up there. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The farm","/#","
","^The house has lost its roof. The fence posts lean. The goat pen holds dry droppings and no goats.","
","^A rope lies coiled beside the well, knotted at even lengths along its whole run. Every knot is dry.","
","ev","str","^Try the tap under the tower.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Call out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The handle squeals. The pipe coughs a thread of rust onto your boots and gives nothing else. You hold it open a while longer anyway.","
",{"->":"shed"},null],"c-1":["
","^You know better, but thirst is louder than sense. Your voice comes out cracked. Nobody answers.","
",{"->":"shed"},null]}],null],"shed":[["#","^checkpoint: shed","/#","^Behind the tower, what's left of a shed has folded in on itself. Under the fallen roof sheet, in the shade, sits a pickup. ","#","^page","/#","
","^It's old and square, built heavy to outlast whoever drove it. The paint has gone to grey primer. The tires are soft but whole, and the bed is boxed in with welded plate.","
","^A machine gun sits on a swivel behind the cab, its barrel wrapped in rag. A pair of steel pins hold the ring. One pin is bright and new, the other worn dull. A small welder's mark is cut into the ring.","
","^Someone has scratched a ladle into the driver's door, deep, with a knife point.","
","ev","str","^Pull the door open.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Wipe the windshield first.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The hinge shrieks, and something small scrabbles out from under the bed. The air in the cab is close and warm, and still cooler than the yard.","
",{"->":"truck"},null],"c-1":["
","^Your palm clears an arc in the dust. Behind it there's a split bench seat patched with tape, a bare metal dash and a tin cup wedged under the mirror.","
",{"->":"truck"},null]}],null],"truck":[["#","^checkpoint: truck","/#","^The bench is hot through your trousers. The cab smells of oil, rope and old tobacco. A key stands in the ignition, with a brass tag on its ring stamped with a number worn half smooth. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You twist the key. The starter grinds, slows and quits.","
","^You twist it again. The engine catches for a breath, shakes the whole cab and dies. You call the truck something you wouldn't call a dog.","
","^You lean your forehead on the hot wheel and wait. Then you try a third time. It coughs, misses, coughs again, and holds. The idle is rough and lopsided, and the mirror shakes with it. It's the best sound you have heard in a long time.","
","ev","str","^Ease out of the shed.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^drive","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^The roof sheet scrapes the length of the cab and slides off the tailgate. Light hits the windshield, and the basin opens up in front of the hood.","
","^The fuel needle sits just above empty. The town in the haze had better be close.","
","end",null]}],null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

intro_bowl.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Somewhere close, a bucket is coming up a well on a creaking rope. It's the first sound in days that isn't wind or an engine. ","#","^place: Bowl","/#","
","^You're lying on a bench under a roof of woven reeds. Past the shade run canals full of slow brown water. Past them the terraces climb, green enough to hurt your eyes.","
","ev","str","^Sit up.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^done","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"intro_step","re":true},"^Your head swims, then settles. Your pickup stands crooked at the edge of the yard with its hood propped open. A tow chain that isn't yours hangs coiled off the bumper. It has a brass tag, like the one on your key.","
","^The bed is empty. Somebody went through the engine bay in a hurry and left the bolts where they fell.","
",{"->":"hattie"},null]}],null],"hattie":[["^A broad woman with flour on her forearms sets a cup of water on the bench beside you. Then she sits down at the other end of it. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Drink it slow. A tow man brought you in at first light, set you on my bench and drove off before I got a word out of him. No name, and no coin either. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","^She nods at the chain on your bumper.","
","^He did ask after a Varga woman. There's a Ruth Varga on the third terrace who buys her water here every morning and pays in sorghum. Whether she's his Varga, he didn't stay to find out. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","^The yard by the gate sells back whatever they took, if you have the coin. You look like someone who eats first and pays later, so I'll put the grain on your slate. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","ev","str","^Drink.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^The water is cold and tastes of stone. You drink it too fast and your teeth ache. A bowl of hot grain comes after it without being asked for.","
","end",null]}],null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}
