{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Order Bureau, records. Keep your voice down, please. The corridor listens.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What does the Bureau do?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is wrong with the steel mounts?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_mounts"},{"VAR?":"asked_mounts"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is in the account box?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_box"},{"VAR?":"asked_box"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell me about Emil Kessel.","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kessel"},{"VAR?":"asked_kessel"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What case did she prove?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_case"},{"VAR?":"asked_case"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What about the depot business?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^We keep files, and each file keeps a person. Please don't ask me whose. I sign for the steel mounts the line hands out with the gate passes. On market days I carry the Committee's account box to the Pierce office, where the insurers sit. Those are the errands I'm trusted with.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_box","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_mounts","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every one of them has a single pin. I signed for each one anyway. That's the part I think about at night. The first file I opened on the matter was the death of a driver named Emil Kessel.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_mounts","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kessel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^I don't know. It goes in heavy and comes back lighter. I don't open it, and I don't count what's inside. A clerk who counts is a clerk who gets asked questions later.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_box","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^I filed it. He was a driver on the north bend. His mount slid on its single pin and swung the gun into the cab. A captain signed the file, and nobody wrote a word about the pin. His sister is an inspector of this Bureau, Mara Kessel. She serves at the Army post inside the Salvage Yard now, and she doesn't come to this corridor. She once proved a case in these rooms. It's closed.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kessel","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_case","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^I only say what the corridor says. A clerk at the Pierce office sold the roads of insured trucks to robbers. When it came out, he was sent west and told to stay. The Bureau had a case, and the case is closed. I carry the box that closed it.","
","ev","str","^talkClerkWest","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_case","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Corporal Vance. His file came to us by dusk. The Army likes a short file.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Pell's in a cell, and no page in my box says why. A cell with no page is a Bureau habit. I don't like it.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Dispatch says the depot's clean. A clean report with no file behind it gets read twice in this corridor.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^The trail's gone cold, and cold trails go in the drawer.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","

","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_mounts"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_mounts"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_box"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_box"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kessel"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kessel"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_case"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_case"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The Pierce office at Nose is a narrow room with a high desk and a locked cabinet. The only chair in it stands on Constance Pierce's side. She doesn't rise when you come in, and she finishes adding her column before she looks up.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^proof","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The board has the file now, and my cousin hasn't spoken to me since. I call that a fair price for having it. I'll thank you once for the paper and I won't repeat myself. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^lucan","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^My cousin has a new clerk this month who does nothing I can see. I find myself wondering what the clerk is for. I also hear your name is written on a receipt in his book, and that interests me more than the clerk does. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^buried","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You told me nothing. I'll go on believing that for exactly as long as it stays believable. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^forged","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The board asked Otto Brann about a crate lid, and he told them he'd never seen it. I don't blame you for being useful. I do blame you for being careless. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^pierce","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You brought me a ring from the Yard, and I've written that down. I don't forget a favor, so you may take it that the account is open. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^State your business, please. Pierce charges by the quarter hour, and we write paper only on trucks with a gun on a proper mount. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why only trucks with a gun?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What makes a mount proper?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rule"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Where did all the rifles come from, if you don't ask?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rule"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^You look like someone with a problem.","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_guns"},{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I'm Constance Pierce, head underwriter at this office. I decide which trucks the company will bet on and what each bet costs. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^Augustin Pierce was my great-grandfather. I'd prefer you didn't use his name as a key, because it opens fewer doors than people think. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_rule","re":true},"^Because I wrote that rule, and I wrote it for arithmetic. A driver without a gun loses his load, and then we pay his family. A driver with a gun keeps it, or at least makes it expensive for whoever takes it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I don't claim it makes the road pleasant. I don't ask where the rifles came from, either. I ask only whether one is on the truck. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^It needs a pin on each side of the ring. A single pin can slide on a hard bend, and the gun swings round into the cab. Then we pay for a driver and a truck both. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^Nose issues its drivers a mount with one pin, so we write no paper on it. They pay the Salvage Yard to bore the second. That isn't my doing, and I don't stop it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_guns","re":true},"^The Old Army's, for the most part. The old Pierce yard held some of its trucks against a debt, and the guns left that yard in crates. I know that much because I've read the books. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I read the books before I trust any story about where a thing went. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^I have a cousin named Lucan, who runs this company. Before the yard went its own way, it crated the Army's guns for sale. Some crates were marked with a wheel on the lid, and some had a hook burned into it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^The wheel crates went to a dealer at the crossroads who sold to drivers. The hook crates went north. Scrapjaw has more rifles than the road ought to hold, and I can't prove who sent them. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","^I won't ask a clerk of mine to look, because every clerk in this building has a cousin. Find me a paper or a mark a board will read. And please don't say his name aloud in this room. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",["ev","str","^I'll look.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my business.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^cratesAsk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^I never forget a favor, and I never forgive a debt. Remember both, and you'll do well with me. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
","ev","str","^crates_hook","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-1":["
","^Then we haven't spoken. You may leave the door as you found it. ","#","^speaker: Constance","/#","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-5":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_rule"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_guns"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^stat: money Money","/#","#","^fact: vesna_said Vesna: a new rider holds the south bend this season. His truck carries a Brann swivel.","/#","#","^fact: letter_seen Mail bag: a thick letter capped with a Burnt Convoy tin seal, addressed to Karl Vosk, care of Kiln Camp.","/#","#","^fact: drinkers_said Green Pit tables: the new Kiln rider asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the Guild paint.","/#","#","^fact: read_rider South bend: the rider's swivel is bolted on but empty, and his hand shakes on the fender.","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#",["ev",{"VAR?":"result"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str","!=","||","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
",{"->":"after_loop"},{"->":"start.5"},null]}],["ev",{"VAR?":"riding"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
",{"->":"post"},{"->":"start.5"},null]}],"nop","
","^Tamsin Roe leans on the fender of a truck with a blue stripe down its door, reading a letter that isn't hers. ","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","^She folds it away when she sees you, without any hurry.","
","^You're the one the Guild sent? Good. I'm Tamsin. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^Vesna Hale rides behind me, always. She has the rifle and I have the wheel. But she's down with a fever, and the south loop won't wait for her. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^It's the Pump Station, Bowl, Green Pit and home. The Guild pays for the whole loop, and all I need is someone in the back seat. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^One thing first, though. I carry no gun. Not for you, not for Vesna, not for the Guild. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^You really carry no gun at all?","/str",{"VAR?":"asked_gun"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^I'll ride behind you.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not this loop.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gun","re":true},"^I really don't. The Kiln riders know my truck, and they let it pass because it's unarmed. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^Besides, I read what people carry. In all the letters I've read, nobody ever wrote home that a gun made them braver. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"riding","re":true},"^Good. Go and see Vesna if you like, since she knows the road better than I do. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null],"c-2":["
","^Then Vesna goes out sick. You'd better tell her yourself, because I won't. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"post":[["#","^checkpoint: post","/#","^The bay smells of oil and cold tea. Tamsin checks the strap on the mail bag, then checks it again. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","ev","str","^See Vesna first.","/str",{"VAR?":"met_vesna"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask to see the mail bag.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ride out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"vesna"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"bag"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"road"},null]}],null],"vesna":[["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"met_vesna","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"vesna_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierVesna","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Vesna lies in a room above the radio shack with a blanket up to her chin and a rifle across the chair beside her. ","#","^place: Above the radio shack","/#","
","^She watches the window and not you. Her eyes go to the mirror on the wall every time a truck passes below.","
","^Kiln riders take the trucks that run alone. A new one has come to the south bend this season, and I never saw his face. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^I saw his truck from a long way off, though. It carried a Brann swivel, so he didn't build it himself. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^Tamsin thinks her blue paint is a wall. It's paint. Take the rifle. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","^At Green Pit you'll want to hang it on the hook by Hadiza Okon's door before you drink. Everyone does, haulers and Kiln riders alike, and that's the only reason her canteen stays peaceful. Bring it back to me afterward. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
","ev","str","^Take Vesna's rifle.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Leave it with her.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"gun","re":true},"^She shuts her eyes. Her hand stays on the arm of the chair a moment after the rifle is gone.","
",{"->":"post"},null],"c-1":["
","^Then you ride bare, like Tamsin. I hope the paint is enough for you. ","#","^speaker: Vesna","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null]}],null],"bag":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_seen","re":true},"ev","str","^courierLetter","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tamsin loosens the strap and lets you look. ","#","^place: Guild post, Nose","/#","
","^She carries other people's letters for free, and she reads every one of them. Most are small. A mother to a son in the Bowl patrol, a bill from a welder, and a note for the Pump Station with nothing on it but a date.","
","^One thick envelope is capped with a Burnt Convoy tin seal. It's addressed to Karl Vosk, care of Kiln Camp.","
","^Nobody writes to Kiln, so I'm carrying it myself. Someone wrote to him once, and that's all a letter ever tells you. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
",{"->":"post"},null],"road":["^Tamsin pushes the loop sheet across the hood. There's a line on it for the pair, and you scratch your name there because the Guild won't send a bag out without one. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Pump Station road","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Vesna's rifle lies across your knees. Tamsin doesn't look at it. ",{"->":"road.12"},null]}],"nop","
","^The road follows the old canal bank south, and dust hangs in the air all the way back to the hills.","
","^At the Pump Station Tamsin leaves the note with only a date on it. Agnes Ondra's meter board hangs by the door, and every line on it reads lower than last spring.","
",{"->":"lock"},null],"lock":[["^The Bowl gate stands where the road meets the first terraces, and a man in a Bowl coat steps into the road with his hand up. ","#","^place: Bowl gate","/#","
","^He has a patrol badge and a worn letter in his other hand. Behind him a second patrolman sits on the gate wall with a kettle between his boots.","
","^Morning, courier. The patrol's looking in every bag that comes through this season. Folks in Kiln have friends, and we'd like to know who writes to them. ","#","^speaker: Corporal","/#","
","^He says it kindly, which makes it worse. Tamsin keeps both hands on the wheel.","
","^The Guild doesn't open a bag for anyone. I'd sooner lose the road. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","ev","str","^Let Tamsin hold her ground.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Talk to the corporal.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Slip the thick letter into the door panel.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell Tamsin to show him the bag.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_refused"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_talk"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_hide"},null],"c-3":["
",{"->":"lock.lock_read"},null]}],{"lock_refused":["ev","str","^refused","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^Tamsin says it again, slowly, and the corporal looks at her for a long moment. ","#","^place: Bowl gate","/#","
","^Then he lowers his hand and steps aside. The Guild's been good to my mother, he says, and I'd sooner not be the one who stops it.","
","^The word will still reach the toll hut that a Guild truck wouldn't be looked into. Bowl remembers a closed bag.","
",{"->":"green"},null],"lock_talk":["ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^talked","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^You ask him about the letter in his hand, and he tells you it's from his mother, who lives on a farm below the Granary. You tell him what a mother wants a courier to carry, and that the bag is full of letters just like his.","
","^He laughs and waves you on. Nothing in a mother's bag would help Kiln, he says.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^You talk, but you talk like a man hiding something. The corporal's eyes go to the bag.","
","^Sorry, courier. I'll have to look after all. ","#","^speaker: Corporal","/#","
","^He opens the strap himself. The thick envelope with the Burnt Convoy seal is on top, and he reads the address aloud, twice, as if he were memorizing it.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"lock_hide":["ev","str","^machining","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^hidden","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"^While Tamsin argues about the Guild's rules, you pry the inside panel from the door with a fingernail and push the thick letter into the gap. The panel snaps back flat.","
","^The corporal searches the bag and finds a mother's letter, a welder's bill and a date. He lets you through, a little ashamed.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^You pry at the panel, and the clip snaps with a crack that carries across the gate. The corporal looks round.","
","^The letter is lying on the floor of the cab with the Burnt Convoy seal facing up. He picks it up and reads the address, and he gives it back with great care.","
",{"->":"green"},{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"lock_read":["ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"lock_way","re":true},"ev","str","^read","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"^Tamsin stares at you. Then she hands the bag down without a word. ","#","^place: Bowl gate","/#","
","^The corporal goes through it as kindly as he does everything. He stops at the thick envelope and reads the address.","
","^Karl Vosk, at Kiln. He says the name twice. I thank you, he says. The patrol's been asking after that name for a long time.","
",{"->":"green"},null]}],"green":[["#","^checkpoint: green","/#","^Green Pit is a pump yard behind a wall of stacked drums under green tarp. Water tanks stand over it on steel legs, and the pump thuds day and night like a slow heart. Hadiza Okon's canteen leans against the tank wall. Rifles hang on iron hooks by its door, because everyone hangs their gun before they drink. That's how raiders and haulers share one room. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev","str","^green-pit","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You know this place. Hadiza Okon fills the cups herself, as before. ",{"->":".^.^.^.19"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Hadiza Okon fills the cups herself, and charges for them, and nobody argues with the hooks. ",{"->":".^.^.^.19"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^Hang Vesna's rifle on a hook, like everyone.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Keep the rifle on your shoulder.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Sit down with Tamsin.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"drinkers_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierRider","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^The tables go on talking. A hauler says the new Kiln rider sat here last week with his coat buttoned to the neck, and he left his rifle on his truck.","
","^He asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the blue stripe.","
","^Tamsin sets down her cup. She doesn't say anything.","
",{"->":"bend"},null],"c-1":["
","^The talk at the tables stops when you pass. Hadiza Okon looks at the empty hook, then at you, and fills Tamsin's cup first.","
","^Nobody tells you anything. Tamsin drinks standing.","
",{"->":"bend"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"drinkers_said","re":true},"ev","str","^courierRider","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^A hauler says the new Kiln rider sat here last week with his coat buttoned to the neck, and he left his rifle on his truck.","
","^He asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the blue stripe.","
","^Tamsin sets down her cup. She doesn't say anything.","
",{"->":"bend"},null]}],null],"bend":[["#","^checkpoint: bend","/#","^South of the pit the road climbs to a bend between rock shoulders. One truck stands crosswise on the rise with a Brann swivel bolted to its bed. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","
","^The rider on it is alone. He wears an Army coat, and the cuff is stitched with red thread.","
","^Tamsin stops the truck and keeps both hands on the wheel.","
","^Courier. Guild paint. You know it. ","#","^speaker: Tamsin","/#","
","^He doesn't answer. He has never seen the paint.","
","ev","str","^Tell Tamsin to hand over the thick letter.","/str",{"VAR?":"letter_seen"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Raise Vesna's rifle.","/str",{"VAR?":"gun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Pay the rider ","ev",{"VAR?":"toll"},"out","/ev","^ M. ",{"->":"letter"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"armed"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"toll_paid"},null],"c-3":["
",{"->":"reading"},null],"c-4":["
",{"->":"wheel"},null],"c-5":["
",{"->":"stripped"},null]}],null],"letter":["ev","str","^kept","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"result","re":true},"ev","str","^delivered","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"letter_fate","re":true},"ev","str","^courierKarl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tamsin reaches into the bag without looking and holds out the thick letter. ","#","^place: South bend","/#","

facts.name: vesna_said
facts.text: Vesna: a new rider holds the south bend this season. His truck carries a Brann swivel.

facts.name: letter_seen
facts.text: Mail bag: a thick letter capped with a Burnt Convoy tin seal, addressed to Karl Vosk, care of Kiln Camp.

facts.name: drinkers_said
facts.text: Green Pit tables: the new Kiln rider asked what the courier bag carries. He had never seen the Guild paint.

facts.name: read_rider
facts.text: South bend: the rider's swivel is bolted on but empty, and his hand shakes on the fender.

facts.name: ledger_read
facts.text: Ledger: cans went missing on the third, seventh and eleventh nights. Pell was on duty each time.

facts.name: gate_checked
facts.text: Gate log: Corporal Vance signed out late on the third, seventh and eleventh nights, alone, with an empty truck bed.

facts.name: saw_swap
facts.text: Fuel shed: Vance asked Pell to swap shifts tonight. Pell agreed without looking up. Vance has a scar across his chin.

facts.name: knows_scar
facts.text: Sabine: a corporal brings her the cans. Big hands, a scar across the chin. Never a name.

facts.name: found_seals
facts.text: Barracks: a tin of Army fuel seals under Vance's cot, cut clean.

facts.name: saw_handoff
facts.text: Back fence: at dawn Vance passed cans over the wire to a truck with Sabine's mark.

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Eh? Pull up a crate. I'm Ibo. I listen to the air for the Army, and to everything else for myself.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do in this shack?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What was the Old World like?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_oldworld"},{"VAR?":"asked_oldworld"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Bowl folk?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_bowl"},{"VAR?":"asked_bowl"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard anything interesting on the air?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where does Jill Jane broadcast from?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_jj"},{"VAR?":"asked_jj"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What does the tone from the hull say?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},{"VAR?":"asked_tone"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who are the Guild couriers?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_couriers"},{"VAR?":"asked_couriers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What happened at Burnt Convoy?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_convoy"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_convoy"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^How did the Old Army end?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_army"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who pays for the Old Orchard tools?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tools"},{"VAR?":"asked_tools"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard about the depot business?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Freeze, mostly, and listen. The Army pays me for its own calls, and whatever else drifts through I keep for myself. There's Jill Jane, who runs Waste Of Time Radio and comes in best after dark. There's the couriers of the Guild calling their rounds. And now and then there's a tone out of the big hull that nobody can explain. The set itself is Old World work, built back when there were masts on every hill. It's cold work, but it's quiet, and I never wanted better.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_jj","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_couriers","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Bigger than anyone here thinks. Bowl folk will tell you it was all orchards, and that's rubbish. There were highways, power lines, towns bigger than Nose and Bowl put together. The orchards were only what you could see from the canals. I knew men of the Old Army who could drive a mountain road blind, and there's nobody like them left.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Good people, slow talkers. They'd hold a meeting to decide whether to hold a meeting. Still, their grain keeps us fed, so the Army minds its manners with them.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Scavengers gab about the Burnt Convoy now and then, that row of burnt trucks the road crews hauled off. Picked clean, they say. The stretch is all ash and bent rims, and not worth the fuel to go and look.","
","ev","str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Nobody knows, but I'd wager she moves it. Her signal's strongest at night, and it drifts like the mast is on wheels. Don't tell the Sergeant I listen to her. He thinks this shack is for the Army alone.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_jj","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Ines Abend, who reads it out front, says it counts the years since the fall. A tone's a tone, though. I've listened a long while and I hear a tone. If it counts, it counts without me.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They carry the mail between the towns. They run in pairs now, one to drive and one to hold the gun. I remember when they went out alone, before the Kiln riders got bold. Kiln's the raider camp in the south. Tamsin Roe's the odd one, with no gun at all. I hear her call-sign more than any other.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_couriers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A whole convoy went up in one night, years back. Some say raiders did it. Some say a fuel truck blew and took the rest with it. I heard the last calls on the air, and nobody said who started it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Hungry. Commander Lind nailed a book of every unpaid promise to the gate at Old Orchard, the Army's depot, and then he died in the motor pool. I heard his last calls on the air. He read the whole list. The machine tools stayed behind in the shed, and somebody's still paying for those.","
","^Some say the Army didn't run out of food. They say it was starved on purpose. I say a man who starts a rumor like that wants a seat in the hall.","
","ev","str","^talkArmyStarved","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^The Guild's trust owns them and rents them to us. Command pays the Guild, and the Guild hears who pays command. I hear the Guild on the air, a little. I won't repeat it. Ask at the Pierce office who pays what.","
","ev","str","^talkCommitteeRent","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Vance! He sat at my table on cold nights, and I'd have trusted him with my radio. You never know a man until he sells you out.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Pell? That man can't steal a biscuit without saying sorry to it. Somebody else is laughing tonight.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The depot's clean, they say. Funny, then, that the trader by the gate still sells fuel cheap.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Fuel still goes missing, they say. It's not my business, and it's not yours either, now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_army"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_army"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tools"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tools"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^I'm Ines Abend, of the Lunar Society. If you have a moment, I'll read you the count. I read it to anyone who stops.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is the count?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who are the Lunar Society?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why read it out loud to anyone?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do the old families ask for it?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_families"},{"VAR?":"asked_families"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who is Teo?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_teo"},{"VAR?":"asked_teo"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why is the Society kept from the rim?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rim"},{"VAR?":"asked_rim"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the Sunward chant at the rim?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_chant"},{"VAR?":"asked_chant"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What happens when the count stops?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_end"},{"VAR?":"asked_end"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^A tone comes out of the central hull. It repeats a number, and the number grows by one each year. The tower has listened to it since my great-grandfather's day. We think it counts the years since the fall. This year's number hangs by the tower door, in my hand.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^We watched the sky from the Alpha Tower, to learn where the ship came from and whether more are coming. We were many once. Now there are few of us, scattered. I keep the tower door and read the count from there and from here. The old families of Nose keep asking me for it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_families","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^A number kept in one head is a number kept from everyone. The Society voted on it, and I spoke first for reading it in the open. Teo wouldn't agree. He'd kept the count close since he was young. When the vote went against him, the Society cast him out.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_teo","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Many of them have a grandmother who woke in a pod. They want to know how long they've been waiting. I tell them the number, and they nod. Some of them say a word in the old tongue.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_families","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Teo took the tower when my great-grandfather died of burns. He read the plate when nobody else could. He read the count to me at the crater rim and told me to keep reading it after him. People call him the Apprentice now. I don't. He was never anyone's apprentice but the sky's. After the vote, the Sunward closed the rim to us. They're the people who keep it. I haven't stood there since.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_teo","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_rim","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The Sunward shut it to us after the vote. Their Preacher says we count their god's patience. I'd call that fair, if I believed in the god. We read from the tower now, and from here. The glow doesn't mind. The Sunward chant a number of their own at the rim. I'd give a great deal to know where they found it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rim","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_chant","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^A number, and it's larger than this year's. I believe it's where the count stops. I don't know how they came to it. Someone must have read further than we have.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardNumber","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_chant","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_end","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^I don't know. Nobody does. Anyone who says he knows is selling something. I read the count anyway. A thing not read is a thing that happens to you.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_end","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_families"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_families"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_teo"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_teo"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_rim"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_rim"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_chant"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_chant"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_end"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_end"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","^Nose. The dispatch desk is mine. Freight on the north-east road or through the canyon crossing passes this desk, or it doesn't pass. If you want something to be proud of, ask the Committee about the workshop line. It builds whole engines and guns. Bowl can't.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^On paper the Central Committee. In the street the Army. Command gives me orders, I hand them down, nobody argues. I hear Bowl votes on everything. I wouldn't last a morning there.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Bad once you're past the walls. Nobody keeps the road between our wall and Bowl's. Kiln riders, the raiders from the camp in the south, strip any truck that won't pay or fight. I log every truck out and every truck in. The ones that don't come back are the part I like least. That's why no truck gets out without a gun. That's the gate law. One courier goes without. I haven't decided what I think of her.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["

","^Him. He sold us our own radio back. I'll admit the nerve impressed me. That set came off wagon Seven. She went dark on the Pump Station run down to Bowl. The crew walked into Nose with raiders on their heels. The scavenger swears she sits a short hop off the track. Nobody went to look. She's too far off our road to spare a truck.","
","ev","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^I heard. She was written off long ago, so whatever's left on her is yours. Just don't make a habit of picking over Army property.","
","ev","str","^wagonFound","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Old Orchard, the Old Army's depot. The machine tools are the Guild's, and command rents them. Who pays that rent is above my sheet.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^No gun, no gate pass. The line hands every driver a steel mount with his pass, so nobody can tell me he had nothing to bolt on. What happens to the mount after that is between the driver and Pierce. Pierce writes his paper. I don't ask.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Tamsin Roe, of the Guild. The Guild carries the mail between the towns. She drives with no gun of her own. The courier who runs with her carries the rifle. A pair gets through my gate, but I don't like what it teaches the other drivers. Brave or stupid, I haven't decided.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^It's the insurance that pays a driver when his truck is shot. Constance Pierce writes it at the Pierce office. She won't write it for a mount with one pin. Command ordered one pin. So drivers pay the Salvage Yard, south of here, to bore a second. I don't log it. Emil Kessel went round the north bend with only one.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kessel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^He was a driver. His mount shifted on its pin at the north bend and swung the gun into his cab. The inquiry's closed. I won't reopen it for you. His sister serves at the Yard post now. That's the Army post inside the Salvage Yard.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kessel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Lena. If it's broken, put it on the bench. If it's talk, make it quick. My hands are busy.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any advice for my truck?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where do I find cheap parts?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get clean water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why look at the pins?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_pins"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you trust Brann's mounts?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Kiln riders?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is there anything for the glare?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I keep the Army's trucks running. Anybody else's too, if they bring them to my bench. Engines, plate, mounts, whatever breaks. I can tell what's wrong with a truck by the sound of it pulling in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every part does one job and fails at another. Heavy plate stops rounds, but it eats your speed. A big gun eats your deck on top of that. So buy what the road needs, not what shines on the shelf. And if you've got a gun on a swivel, look at the pins first. The swivel's the ring that swings the gun across your bed.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Salvage Yard, a way south of here. The crews strip whatever gets towed in, so parts go for next to nothing. You'll have to put up with the smell of burnt oil. For real plate you want the Fallen Sun, the big hull in the crater. I say that through my teeth.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Green Pit, out past the road. It's a pump outpost behind a wall of drums, and they pull the water up from deep rock and sell it by the can. It's clean, and it isn't cheap. Bring coin.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Because the copy they bolt on at the gate has one. I've seen what one does on a hard bend. The mount slides and the gun swings round into your own cab. Otto Brann made the first swivel, and he still welds at the Salvage Yard. He gave his a second pin. He was right, and I told command so. Nobody asks a mechanic. The Yard will bore you a second pin for a fee. Pay it.","
","ev","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pins","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The ones with his mark, yes. He signs every weld. A weld you can read is a weld you can trust. I've even seen Kiln riders running captured ones on their own trucks. Good steel doesn't care who owns it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They're raiders from the camp in the south, and I'd sooner not fix a truck they've stripped. But the old woman who keeps their furnace, Dagny Brask, melts captured guns into tools. I own a few. They're decent. Don't tell command I said so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Best metal I ever put a torch to, and the worst place to fetch it. The brass call that hull a warship. I'd like them to show me one gun mount on it. There isn't one. It's cargo holds, all of it. And the glare off the glass around it will blind you by noon.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Lenses. Pim Arslan cuts them from the fused glass at the Yard, and they come out dark as smoke. They're worth it. I wear a pair on bad days.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_swivel"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pins"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_brann"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_glare"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_glare"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","^Those trucks are the army, and I am still on duty. I have counted them every dawn since the Bowl put me in this coat. ","#","^speaker: Ilya","/#","
","^The gate was shut all night. I slept in the blockhouse with the door open, as I always do. This morning I counted the rows again, and again, and a third time, and the sum would not change. ","#","^speaker: Ilya","/#","

facts.name: wall_read
facts.text: Blockhouse wall: coats of paint, one number over another. This morning's number is one short of the last.

facts.name: gap_seen
facts.text: Motor pool: an empty slot at the end of the third row. The chocks are still in place and the ground under it is swept.

facts.name: ilya_said
facts.text: Ilya: the gate was shut all night and he slept in the blockhouse. He has counted every dawn and never been wrong.

facts.name: stub_read
facts.text: Gate stub book: at dusk a Pierce cart passed the gate with a release paper for one truck.

facts.name: release_read
facts.text: Release paper: the Pierce lien number matches the one on the chocks of the empty slot. The seal of the Archon's household is on it.

facts.name: marks_seen
facts.text: Motor pool: fresh chalk ticks on the doors of the cabs beside the empty slot. A few of them carry no dust on the handles.

facts.name: saw_cut
facts.text: North bend: Emil's wreck is bare. The ring under the gun was torched off at the base, and the bolts still stand in the bed.

facts.name: boots
facts.text: North bend: the boot prints of soldiers lie under the stripper's tracks.

facts.name: yard_tally
facts.text: Yard tally: a Nose steel ring, torch cut, bought as scrap the week Emil died and sold on to a Kiln hauler.

facts.name: otto_read
facts.text: Otto: a Nose ring carries the gate stamp on its flat and a single pin hole. A Brann ring has a small mark and a second pin hole.

facts.name: saw_roster
facts.text: Crane office: Captain Silver's patrol roster lies in a drawer, copied twice in one small hand. The corner of one copy says M. Kessel.

facts.name: post_ahead
facts.text: Yard tally: a Nose soldier stood at the end of the bench and wrote nothing.

facts.name: has_ring
facts.text: Kiln: the ring with the gate stamp and a single pin hole.

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Pump book: a pipe to the Archon's terrace draws seep water every week. No meter reads it.

facts.name: early_lines
facts.text: Pump book: the first line for the pipe is in Wendell's hand, a year before the Senate struck the meter.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Pump book, last margin, in Agnes's hand: if this reaches the Senate floor, say a driver found it.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Terrace valve: the wheel is worn bright on one side. An empty flange sits below it, its bolt holes clean.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Household: a steward in a Marr coat offered coin to lose the bundle on the road.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Canal book: the same weekly line for the pipe, in Mirela's hand.

facts.name: report_named
facts.text: Bowl lock house: Tomas Duarte wrote a patrol report on the valve. It lies on the Archon's desk.

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^They walked to Nose, the way I heard it. They were lucky. Whoever ran that wagon down wasn't out for prisoners. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["

",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["

",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["

","^Pim Arslan sits behind a plank counter with a diamond saw and a heap of dark glass, and the saw whines every time she touches a lump of it. She holds a lens up to the sun and squints through it before she looks at you. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard stalls","/#","
","^Glass from the Flats. It cuts the glare and shows what the glare hides, which is more useful than it sounds. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^She sets the lens down and rubs her thumb on her apron, as if the glass had left something there.","
","^I've a favor to ask of somebody who doesn't look like anybody. I haven't found such a person yet. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Buy a smoke lens. ","#","^cost: ","ev",{"VAR?":"lens_price"},"out","/ev","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"lens_held"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask what the favor is.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"lens_held","re":true},"^She wraps it in a rag and sets it in your hand. It's cool and heavier than it looks.","
","^Look through it before you decide what you see. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"errand"},null],"c-2":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"errand":[["^Pim lowers her voice, though only the stalls are listening. ","#","^place: Salvage Yard stalls","/#","
","^It's about Hadiza Okon, who runs the pump and the canteen at Green Pit. She feeds anyone once, and she has a rule at her door. Everybody hangs their rifle on a hook by the threshold before they drink, so that raiders, haulers and Yard crews can share one room without a gun in it. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^A Nose soldier from Silver's post sits by those hooks now. He's polite, and he writes. Hadiza wants to know what he writes and who reads it, and she asked me for someone she doesn't know. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","^You're nobody she knows. I scratched the lean lines of the Flats' glass on a plate and hung it by her door, so she'll listen if you say I sent you. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","ev","str","^I'll go to Green Pit.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my fight.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^hooksSoldier","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Tell her I sent you. And hang your rifle on the hook, because nobody drinks there with it on. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
",{"->":"arrive"},null],"c-1":["
","^Then drink somewhere else. ","#","^speaker: Pim","/#","
","end",null]}],null],"arrive":["^Green Pit is a pump yard behind a wall of stacked drums under green tarp. Water tanks stand over it on steel legs, the pump thuds day and night, and the air smells of wet iron and diesel. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^Hadiza's canteen leans against the tank wall. Rifles hang on the iron hooks by its door, many of them, like coats in a hall. A scratched plate hangs beside them, and every line on it leans the same way.","
","ev","str","^green-pit","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You know the place. ",{"->":"arrive.18"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ In a dry year the pump draws mud by noon. Nobody here says so out loud. ",{"->":"arrive.18"},null]}],"nop","
","^Hadiza Okon fills a cup before you speak.","
","^Hang it on the hook. Everyone drinks here, and nobody takes my pump. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^Her chin points at a young man in a Nose coat on a stool by the hooks. He has a sheet on a board across his knees.","
","^That's the soldier. He came with the dry year. He sits, he watches, and he writes. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^I feed him once a day, same as anyone. I want to know what he writes and who reads it. Then I want you to tell me what I should do about it. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
",{"->":"hooks"},null],"hooks":[["#","^checkpoint: hooks","/#","^The soldier doesn't look up. The pump thuds behind the wall, and now and then a rifle clinks on its hook. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"saw_hooks"},"!","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A man who watches the watcher gets seen. ",{"->":".^.^.^.16"},null]}],"nop","

","^You hold the dark glass to your eye, and the soldier becomes a shape on a stool with the light carved out of his edges.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You look at nothing in particular and watch him from the edge of your eye, the way a hunter watches a bird.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
","^A hauler hangs a rifle. The soldier doesn't move his head, but his pencil moves.","
","^A Kiln rider hangs one, and the pencil moves again. A welder from the Yard comes next, then another rider, and the pencil keeps pace.","
","^He never looks at the faces. He looks at the stocks, at the stamp cut into the wood, a wheel or a hook. He writes the stamp, and then he writes who hung it.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"watch.17"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You stare at the soldier for far too long. He lifts his head, meets your eyes and writes a line on his sheet.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^He doesn't say a word, but the pencil has got your face now.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"watch.17"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"drinkers":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_drinkers","re":true},"^The tables go quiet when you ask, then loosen. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^He asks nothing. He only counts. ","#","^speaker: Kiln rider","/#","
","^He counted my crew when I was here with the Yard. Names, I think. I don't like my name written down. ","#","^speaker: Yard welder","/#","
","^Hadiza doesn't like it either. She says so with the soup. ","#","^speaker: Kiln rider","/#","
",{"->":"hooks"},null],"soldier":["^You sit down beside him. He moves the board a hand's width away and says nothing for a while. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"soldier_talked","re":true},"^You ask him how his week has been. You ask where he's from and whether his mother knows where he sits. He answers the first, then the second, and then his shoulders drop.","
","^I count. I write what I count. The sergeant takes the sheet at the week's end, and the clerk takes it from the sergeant. I don't know what the clerk does with it. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^Hadiza feeds me once a day, and I eat all of it. I'm sorry for what I write. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He looks at the hooks, not at you.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"soldier_shut","re":true},"^You ask what he writes. He closes the board against his chest.","
","^I count. That's all, and I'm not to say more. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He watches you for the rest of the evening, and he writes when you reach for your cup.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"hooks"},{"->":".^.^.^.15"},null]}],"nop","

","^Hadiza brings the soldier a bowl and talks about the pump. He sets the board down on his knee to take it. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^You have the sheet in your hands for as long as it takes to read it.","
","^Stamp; Hung by ","#","^head","/#","
","^Wheel; Hauler ","#","^row","/#","
","^Hook; Kiln rider ","#","^row","/#","
","^Wheel; Yard welder ","#","^row","/#","
","^Plate by the door; Glass cutter from the Yard stalls ","#","^row","/#","
","^Hook; Kiln rider ","#","^row","/#","
","^Wheel; Yard welder ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every line names a face. The Yard welders and the Kiln riders hang side by side on each one.","
","^You put it back as you found it.","
",{"->":"hooks"},null],"follow":["^At week's end the soldier climbs into a Nose truck with the sheet inside his coat. ","#","^place: The road to the Yard","/#","
","ev","str","^driving","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"saw_drop","re":true},"ev","str","^hooksDrop","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^You keep a long way behind, using the dust of other trucks and the dips in the road. He never looks in his mirror.","
","^The Yard crane stands over the stacked wrecks. Silver's post sits inside the gate, a Nose flag over a tin roof.","
","^The soldier hands the sheet to a clerk. The clerk doesn't read it. He pins it to a board by the captain's door.","
","^A second hand has inked a line under it. Yard crews drink with raiders. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^The line is in better ink than the sheet.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"follow.15"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You stay too close. At the first long straight the soldier's mirror catches your grille.","
","^He stops and gets out. Without a word he writes down the number of your truck, and then he drives on.","
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"follow.15"},null]}],"nop","
",null],"decide":[["^Hadiza stands in the doorway of the inn with a cup in her hand, waiting. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^The soldier writes the marks and the faces, and the captain's clerk adds the rest. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"read_tally"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You read his sheet. It names who hangs beside whom. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza ",{"->":".^.^.^.17"},null]}],"nop","/#","
","^Tell me what I do. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","ev","str","^Tell her all of it and let her settle it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Pay the soldier to write the marks and leave out the faces. ","#","^cost: ","ev",{"VAR?":"bribe"},"out","/ev","/#","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Talk the soldier into writing the stamps and nothing else.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Read his sheet aloud to every table.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Say nothing yet.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"told"},null],"c-1":["

",{"->":"exposed"},null],"c-4":["
",{"->":"hooks"},null]}],null],"told":["ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^You tell Hadiza everything: the marks, the faces, the clerk's second hand and the captain's door. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"read_tally"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ You tell her about the plate and the glass cutter's line. She says Pim's name softly, once, and does not say it again. ",{"->":"told.27"},null]}],"nop","
","^She says nothing until you finish. Then she sets the cup down and goes to the soldier.","
","^She feeds him at her own table, a full meal, with a cup of the good water.","
","^Eat. Then write the stamps. The faces are mine. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^He lowers his eyes and nods. She doesn't ask whether he means it.","
","^She counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M into your hand for the telling. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^The hooks go on holding the rifles. Nobody can say how many sheets reach the captain with faces on them.","
","end",null],"bought":["ev","str","^bought","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^bought","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"^You take the soldier aside behind the inn and put ","ev",{"VAR?":"bribe"},"out","/ev","^ M in his hand. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^He looks at the coins, then at the hooks, then at you. He is quiet for a long time.","
","^I write the stamps. I don't write faces. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^He tucks the money inside his coat.","
","^The sheets go to the captain thinner after that. The clerk's second hand has less to ink under them.","
","^Hadiza says nothing to you. She fills your cup, which is as much as she says to anyone.","
","end",null],"turned":["ev","str","^social","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^turned","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^turned","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"^You find the soldier alone by the well and speak to him as one man speaks to another who was handed a pencil. You tell him what the faces on his sheet are used for, and what Hadiza has fed him.","
","^He's quiet for a while. Then he draws a line down the margin of his board and writes only the stamp column.","
","^They'll send another, you know. But for as long as it's me, I'll write what I'm told and not what I could. ","#","^speaker: Soldier","/#","
","^Hadiza fills your cup when you come in, which is the way she says thanks.","
","end",{"->":"turned.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You find the soldier alone by the well and speak to him badly. He listens to the end, white-faced, and he says nothing back.","
","^The sheet that reaches the clerk that week has a new line under Hadiza's door. The Yard welders are underlined, and a stranger who talks to the soldier is named at the bottom.","
","^Hadiza fills your cup last.","
",{"->":"hooks"},{"->":"turned.10"},null]}],"nop","

Every stamp, every face, every line of the clerk's second hand. ","#","^place: Green Pit","/#","
","^The inn goes still. A Kiln rider takes his rifle off the hook and doesn't put it back.","
","^The Yard welders look at each other. A hauler laughs, then stops.","
","^By midnight the benches are half empty. Rifles leave the hooks in ones and pairs. Nobody argues, and nobody sits.","
","^Hadiza fills your cup last.","
","^I asked you to find out. I didn't ask you to say it. ","#","^speaker: Hadiza","/#","
","^The soldier sits on his stool until dawn with his board on his knees. Nobody comes to eat with him.","
","end",null],"sully":["ev","str","^sully","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"outcome","re":true},"ev","str","^sully","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"hooks_report","re":true},"ev","str","^yard","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"yard_power","re":true},"ev","str","^named","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"post_file","re":true},"^You tell the Administrator about the sheet and the line in better ink. He listens with the coin still in his hand. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: Crane office","/#","
","^He asks you to say the line again. You say it, and he writes it down.","
","^Yard crews drink with raiders. A fine charge, friend, for a post that has been drinking from the Yard's well for a year. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","^I'll put it in front of the Committee in Nose. They owe Pierce more than they owe me, and they hate being asked what a soldier is doing with a pencil. ","#","^speaker: Sully","/#","
","^He doesn't say whose name will go beside the line.","

facts.text: His sheet: a column of faces and stamps. Yard crews sit beside Kiln riders on every line, and the glass cutter from the Yard stalls is on one.

facts.name: saw_drop
facts.text: Silver's post, inside the Yard: a clerk pins the sheet by the captain's door and inks a line under it. Yard crews drink with raiders.

facts.name: soldier_talked
facts.text: The soldier: the sergeant takes his sheet each week, and the clerk takes it from the sergeant.

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The desk at the post gate stands empty, and the ink on the blotter has dried to a grey skin. A clerk says that Mara Kessel sits in the post cell and that nobody may visit her.","
",{"->":"start.gone"},{"->":"start.11"},null]}],"nop","
","^Mara Kessel sits at a desk by the post gate with a pair of ledgers open in front of her. She writes a line in one and copies it with great care into the other. She doesn't look up until you're standing at the edge of the blotter.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^mara","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The ring is where it ought to be. I'd rather not say where, since you're exactly the person who might be asked. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The yard forge ran hot all night. I smelled it from this desk, and I won't pretend I don't know what went into it. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^sully","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear the crane office has a new object in one of its drawers. That pleases me more than I can show on this side of the gate. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pierce","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^A clerk from the Pierce office came to this gate yesterday. He asked me very politely for my brother's full name, and I gave it to him without asking why. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Please keep your voice down. The captain hears a great deal for a man who seems to be reading. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are you?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you write everything twice?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What happened to your brother?","/str",{"VAR?":"knows_emil"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why would Nose issue a mount with one pin?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_pin"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who at Pierce would care about a ring like this?","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^mara","/str","==",{"VAR?":"heard_pierce"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What will you do with the pages I signed?","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^signed","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the post know my name?","/str",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Constance Pierce has proof against her cousin.","/str",{"VAR?":"crates_fate"},"str","^proof","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^You look like someone with a problem.","/str",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==",{"VAR?":"knows_emil"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_emil","re":true},"^I'm Mara Kessel, and I used to be an inspector of the Order Bureau. That's the office Nose uses to look into its own officials. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^These days I count patrols for Captain Silver, which Nose calls a posting. My brother Emil drove the north road before I came here, and that's why I sit at this desk and not another. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Because a page can be lost. I learned in the Bureau that a page and its copy have to be lost separately, by different people, before anything is truly gone. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pin","re":true},"^He died on the north bend last winter. His gun came round on its ring and into his cab, because the pin that should have held it slid on the curve. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^The ring that carries the gun is called a swivel. Emil's had a single pin, where a safe one has a pin on each side, and Nose issued it to him that way with his gate pass. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pierce","re":true},"^To save steel, I'd guess, and an hour of a machinist's time. The line copies a better mount and leaves out whatever is cheap to leave out. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^Pierce, the company that insures salvage runs, won't write paper on a one-pin mount. But Nose drivers don't buy Pierce paper. They buy a gate pass, and the Yard bores the second pin for a fee if they can afford it. Emil couldn't, not before payday. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Constance Pierce, the head underwriter at their office in Nose. She reads every file that crosses her desk, and she's never read one by accident. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^If you go to her, ask who read my old case. Then watch her face before she answers. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Keep them dry, mostly. A page with a witness is worth a great many without one. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^My old case has a second copy in the same drawer. If you ever need to read it, tell the Administrator I said you may. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^It does. The captain keeps a file on everyone who passes his gate, and yours is thicker than it was last week. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I didn't write the new lines in it, and I'd very much like to know who did. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Then the Pierce board is holding my old case under another name. That's fine. A true thing can wear a great many names and still be true. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^There's one thing. When Emil's truck was found, the swivel was still bolted to the bed. By the time anyone from the post rode out there, it had been stripped, as wrecks on the north road usually are. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I'd like the ring that held his gun, the Nose steel one with the single pin hole in it. I can't stop thinking about it. I want to hold it in my own hands. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","^I can't go myself, because the captain reads the gate book every morning and an officer of his post doesn't leave it. I also don't like to ask favors of anyone who owes the post something, and you owe it nothing. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",["ev","str","^I'll find it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not my road.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Thank you. Please tell nobody at the post, not even the soldiers who seem friendly. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
","ev","str","^pin_emil","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-1":["
","^I understand. I wouldn't have asked if I could do it myself. ","#","^speaker: Mara","/#","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null],"gone":[["#","^checkpoint: start.gone","/#","ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"knows_emil"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_pin"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_pierce"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}
