{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sefa Krol. I trade for the families off the Burnt Convoy. Show me what you carry and I'll tell you what it's worth. Keep your hand off my table.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the families of the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you sell here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is the road like out here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who runs this yard?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Burnt Convoy picked clean?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_picked"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_picked"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What was the book you sold the Yard?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_book"},{"VAR?":"asked_book"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What else do you hear about Pierce?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_pguns"},{"VAR?":"asked_pguns"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do you never take the last water?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_water"},{"VAR?":"asked_water"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do the Kiln riders leave you alone?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Has a rider ever come to you with nothing?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rider"},{"VAR?":"asked_rider"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Army post?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_post"},{"VAR?":"asked_post"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^People who lived in the burnt trucks on the road. The road crews cleared the wrecks a while ago, so we moved here, to the north side of the Yard. We're not a camp. A camp has a flag and a man who wants to be called sir. We're first to any wreck and last to leave it. That's all we are. Men on the air say there's nothing left out there to pick. They're welcome to think so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_picked","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^What the road is done with. Wiring, wheel rims, a gun with its pin broken. Anything with a second life in it, if you're not too proud to give it one. I buy too, so put what you carry on the table. Keep your hand off it. Years ago we sold the Yard a book we took off a Pierce truck, and people still ask me about it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_book","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Dry. Every driver sits with his water between his feet. I make a point of never taking the last of it from anyone, and you can ask me why. The Kiln riders from the camp in the south mostly leave us alone. You can ask me about that too.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_water","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^The repair crews, since they stopped answering to Pierce. The Administrator keeps them in line. Nose put an Army post inside the gate afterward. We keep to the north side of the yard, where soldiers don't like the wind.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_post","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^No. We pick that road every week and the road leaves more. Rust grows new things. Old Ibo, the radio man at Nose, says otherwise on the air, to men who wouldn't drive out there for a gift. Good. Let him.","
","ev","str","^talkConvoyNotClean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_picked","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^A debtor book. We stopped a Pierce office truck on the road and took it off the seat. Pierce lends to the towns and insures the trucks, so that's a big name to cross. It was page after page of names and sums. I can't read the sums. The zeroes go on too long. The Yard could read them, so I sold it to them. What it says isn't for sale, and what the Yard does with it isn't my business. The crane office has a shut door now. A shut door is a loud thing.","
","ev","str","^talkCraneBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_book","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pguns","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^That Pierce sold the Old Army's guns north to Scrapjaw, then made every driver buy a gun to get paper. I hear it from a pair of drivers who each swear the other one lied. It's good business, if it's true. A man who sells the fire and the bucket never starves.","
","ev","str","^talkPierceGuns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pguns","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A man with no water is a body, and a body is trouble. Leave him his water and he's a fool who walks on. Fools talk less than bodies. Also, my mother would find out. She finds out everything.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^We have a deal. Kiln has a man named Kaplan who knows a fair split. What the riders leave on the road is ours. What we find of their dead, we bury with their boots on. Nobody on either side likes it, which is how you know it works. Anyone who comes to our tables with nothing gets beans and no questions. That goes for a rider as much as a driver.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_rider","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Once. His brother died in the road. He ate our beans for a long time and said little, and then he went south. I won't say his name. It would be rude to the beans.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rider","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^I don't trust it. Mara Kessel writes down who comes and goes through the gate, and she writes it twice. A woman who writes twice is afraid of something.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_post","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"sack_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lamps_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"count_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"lien_standing"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"courier_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"names_vosk"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"hooks_report"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_fate"},"str","^hidden","/str",{"VAR=":"pin_pact"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"crates_fate"},"str","^even","/str",{"VAR=":"yard_power"},"str","^clean","/str",{"VAR=":"post_file"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"kiln_word"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"letter_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_picked"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_picked"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_book"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_book"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_pguns"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_pguns"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_water"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_water"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_rider"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_rider"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_post"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_post"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

yard_silver.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Captain Silver stands at the post gate with his hands clasped behind his back. He's watching the road through the gate as if it owed him something, and he looks round only when your shadow reaches his boots.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^signed","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A single ledger lies open on a table behind him, and a page in it carries your name. ",{"->":"start.13"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_pact"},"str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ A single ledger lies open on a table behind him. ",{"->":"start.23"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"bend_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The north bend is quiet now, and my drivers pass it without trouble. I'd prefer you didn't wait for me to thank you. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^kiln","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear a pair of Kiln riders have been sitting at the north bend all week. Either you did that or you let it be done, and I'll remember which. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^ash","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The man at the north bend still stops my drivers and tells them their mounts are bad. I'm told you were standing next to him when he started again. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bench","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I hear a bench stands at the north bend now, boring second pins for anyone who drives up. My soldiers have orders to leave it alone. That order lasts as long as I say it does. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^exposed","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^A scrap of Kiln red cloth hangs in the window of the crane office, and the Administrator shows it to anyone who asks. I know whose hand carried it to him. I don't forget hands. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^hush","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^We have an understanding about the north bend, you and I. I'd advise you to keep it exactly as it is. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"pin_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^silver","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The ring is ash and the page is filed. That's how I like a matter to end. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^sully","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^I'm told the crane office keeps a ring in a locked drawer. A ring can be carried out of a drawer, Driver, and a drawer can be opened by more than one key. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^State your business, and make it brief. The road doesn't guard itself. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"start.35"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is your post doing here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Nose mount safe?","/str","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"str","^pinStamp","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who bores the second pin into a Nose mount?","/str","str","^pinAsk","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"str","^pinStamp","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^The Yard gate seems to answer to your sergeant now.","/str",{"VAR?":"yard_power"},"str","^post","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^The crane hands stand very close to your gate.","/str",{"VAR?":"yard_power"},"str","^yard","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is my name in your file?","/str",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is there work for me?","/str",{"VAR?":"bend_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^It keeps the Yard safe for honest haulers. The repair crews are skilled with a torch, but they can't hold a gate against raiders. My soldiers can. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Yes. It's cast steel, it swings and it locks. A driver who knows his mount has no trouble with it. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^When a driver does have trouble, it's almost always because he didn't look after what the line gave him. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Yard does, for a fee, and the Administrator sets the fee. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
","^A man who sells a second hole to drivers the line sent out with one is a man who profits from the one. You might ask yourself whether he wants the line to mend its mounts. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It answers to order. The crews are learning quickly what order costs and what it buys. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^They do. A yard that thinks itself free forgets who sent its fuel through this gate last winter. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Every name that crosses my gate is in my file. Some of them are in a second file, and that one is thicker. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"post_file"},"str","^named","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I've no work for you, but I do have a file with your name in it. A man sits on the north bend and stops my drivers to look at their pins. Move him, and I'll shorten that file. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^A man sits on the north bend and stops my drivers. He makes them show him their swivel pins and tells them our mounts are bad. That's a fine thing to hear before a long drive. ","#","^speaker: Silver","/#","
